surface: External source interfaces and API ingress

records.title: External payload boundary rejects top-level and nested authority or secret keys before native preparation
records.surface: External source interfaces and API ingress
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: The active external source/API ingress surface admits typed recorded/offline carriers and thin adapters only. The payload boundary now scans nested payload structures for forbidden authority, credential, trading, order, persistence, and secret keys before constructing or accepting an ExternalPayloadCarrier.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: The existing Tier A external-source interface boundary family was extended before source repair. The pre-repair test failed because nested payload metadata containing api_key and trade_allowed was accepted. The bounded repair replaced top-level-only key checks with recursive forbidden-key discovery shared by carrier validation and validation-result generation.
adjudication_notes: ACABC-0003 is an extend-existing-test-family row for row 5.1. The row hardens existing native boundary rejection proof rather than admitting live clients, credentials, broker adapters, or external network dependencies.
The generated all-surface active-code Atlas was used only as navigation and not as semantic proof.
limitations: This pass does not implement external API clients, broker clients, credentials, dependency additions, or live network IO.
This pass does not mutate runtime trading behaviour, financial/risk policy, original Atlas/Bridge JSON, generated slices, vocabulary data, or unrelated source files.
